\section[o copo]{o copo — a glass (to drink from)}

\label{lesson:PT-C51-copo}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o copo}
\textbf{o copo} — \textquotedblleft{}a glass (to drink from)\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{um copo de água}: a glass of water.
